item.title: Woman sentenced for burglarizing Mary Jane's House of Glass in Portland
item.description: A woman was sentenced to prison for her role in a Southeast Portland Mary Jane's House of Glass burglary, marking the first conviction from Multnomah County's Burglary Task Force.

item.title: Neglect case ends in 3 dead puppies, 23 pets rescued from Oregon home
item.description: The Oregon Humane Society rescued over 20 pets from a property in Southern Oregon, where three puppies were found dead, after a weeks-long investigation prompted by concerned neighbors.

item.title: Sen. Wyden fires back at Trump for calling Oregon Olympic skier a 'real loser'
item.description: U.S. Olympic skier Hunter Hess of Oregon faced backlash from President Donald Trump after speaking out against the political climate in the U.S., prompting Oregon leaders to respond.

item.title: Portland city leaders keep finding unspent taxpayer money. How?
item.description: The City of Portland has discovered millions of dollars of unspent taxpayer money, and the City Administrator is now working to bring in an outside firm to review the books and ensure transparency.

item.title: 'Bigger than basketball': Oregon bill aims to turn Moda Center into 'world-class hub'
item.description: A new bill in the Oregon legislature is aiming to guide renovations for the oldest unrenovated NBA area in the United States -- the Moda Center -- with plans to turn the facility into a "world-class hub" for sports and entertainment.
